name: unrest
description: The conflict between the orders, made observable: a grip/heat/pressure ledger per derived city block, the perceivable signals a band crossing produces, and the incidents that stage on top of them. Phase 1 complete (1a-1d).

config.BLOCK: 12 — the cell is a 12x12 square of grid coordinates (blocks.js)
config.flagKey: unrest_ledger — the one world_flags key this plugin writes, and it is the only writer
config.SIGNAL_WINDOW_MS: 6h — how long a perceivable signal stays answerable, which is what rule 1 gates an incident on (signals.js)
config.MAX_LIVE: 3 — simultaneous incidents CITYWIDE, not per cell (incidents.js)

dataSchema.note: The LEDGER has no table: one versioned world_flags blob, RAM-authoritative with write-behind, because ~10 cells x 4 numbers does not justify a schema change, a registry entry and a read-tier decision. Band memory, the signal record and every live staging are RAM only, deliberately — rule 6 persists the ledger and never the incidents. world_events takes one audit row per staging and is not the ledger.
